_comment: D26. A lower-bound compare on the transaction locktime (extractLocktime(p) >= X, > X, or the reversed spellings X <= ..., X < ..., directly, through a local bound to it, or through a private helper's parameter; currentBlockHeight() is NOT a locktime read: it asserts its own value < 500000000 at every call, so it is a height by construction; a local bound to both it and extractLocktime is still read fail-closed) is a block-height gate unless X is a literal >= 500000000 (> 499999999), which is a timestamp gate and pins the domain itself, or the vacuous >= 0n every locktime passes. Consensus reads an nLockTime >= 500000000 as a Unix timestamp, so an unpinned height gate passes for any such locktime. Every path that carries a gate must also carry an ASSERTED domain pin: extractLocktime(p) < N (0 < N <= 500000000) or <= N (0 <= N < 500000000) for heights, >= N (N >= 500000000) or > N (N >= 499999999) for timestamps, or the reversed spellings, as the asserted condition or a conjunct of its top-level && chain (not under ! or ||). The rule is per path (D18's path walk with two bits: gate seen, pin seen), through if arms, loop bodies and private helpers. A value derived from a locktime read is read fail-closed (any lower-bound compare on it is a gate whatever the bound, and no compare on it is a pin): the result of + - * / % & | ^ << >> or unary - ~ on a read, a ternary with a read in an arm, a builtin call taking a read, and a local or helper parameter of which some binding is not a direct read. Upper-bound and equality compares are not gates. Every tier refuses on the source path (validate) and on the --ir path (ir-release-trap.test.ts); every accept compiles to the same bytes in every tier.
error_template: method '<method>' compares extractLocktime against a lower bound without pinning the locktime domain: consensus reads an nLockTime of 500000000 or more as a Unix timestamp, so on that path any such locktime passes a block-height gate at once. On every path that compares, assert(extractLocktime(preimage) < 500000000n) for a block-height gate, or assert(extractLocktime(preimage) >= 500000000n) for a timestamp gate
